items.label: US Size
items.value: Small=US 4-6, Medium=US 8-10, Large=US 12-14, X-Large=US 16-18. Crafted from lightweight, soft material that keeps you cool and comfortable all day long. For a better fit, we recommend checking our detailed size chart before ordering.

items: Trendy Y2K Revival Design – Embrace the nostalgic Y2K fashion trend with this stylish top, featuring a tie-shoulder detail and a chic boat neckline that together create an eye-catching, modern summer look.

Flattering Ruched & Fitted Silhouette – The ruched fabric and fitted crop design beautifully enhance your silhouette, offering a sexy yet comfortable fit that’s great for showing off your summer style.

Versatile Summer Staple – Whether you're heading to a music festival, enjoying a beach vacation, or going out with friends, this tank top effortlessly transitions from day to night, making it a must-have for every summer adventure. You can pair it with high-waisted shorts, skirts, or jeans for an instantly chic outfit.

items.label: Quality & Care – Made with durable fabric that holds its shape and color. Note
items.value: While the material is designed to be non-see-through, we recommend wearing light-colored undergarments with light-colored tops for optimal discretion.

items.label: Wash Instruction
items.value: Machine washable with laundry bag recommended, do not bleach, iron in low, hang or line dry. Ironing before you wear it to make it look better.
